title: A systematic literature review on logging smell detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.04215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context:Logging is an important part of software development that helps developers monitor systems, understand behavior, and fix problems. But when logging is done poorly, it can introduce logging smells, which are defects that reduce the usefulness of logs or even make them problematic. Objective:This study looks at how logging smells are currently detected. The goal is to better understand the existing research on automatic detection techniques, datasets, and evaluation methods. Method:We conducted a systematic literature review (SLR) of 21 studies focused on detecting logging smells. In this review, we define key logging-related terms, identify and map the types of smells to an existing taxonomy, and examine the detection techniques, datasets, and evaluation strategies used across the studies. translated_title: 关于日志坏味检测的系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 背景：日志记录是软件开发的重要组成部分，它帮助开发者监控系统、理解程序行为并修复问题。但如果日志记录不当，则会引入“日志坏味”（logging smells），即降低日志有用性甚至使日志成为问题的缺陷。目的：本研究考察当前日志坏味的检测现状，旨在更好地理解自动检测技术、数据集和评估方法方面的现有研究。方法：我们对21篇专注于日志坏味检测的研究开展了系统性文献综述（SLR）。在综述中，我们定义了关键的日志相关术语，识别坏味类型并将其映射到现有分类法中，同时考察了这些研究所采用的检测技术、数据集和评估策略。结果：我们发现该领域的研究仍然分散且不一致。例如，目前尚缺乏通用的基准测试和标准化的评估方法。
tldr: 本文通过对21项研究的系统性文献综述，梳理了日志坏味的术语定义与类型分类，考察了现有检测技术、数据集和评估方法，并指出该领域研究仍分散、缺乏统一基准和标准化方法。
